newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's Creditanstalt adds a branch, 2 more seen.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's Creditanstalt adds a branch, 2 more seen.

text.p: Creditanstalt Rt, the Hungarian unit of Creditanstalt Bankverein, will open a new branch later today in Budapest, the bank said in a statement on Friday.
This will be Creditanstalt's seventh branch in Hungary, with five in Budapest and two elsewhere in the country.

In the near future, the bank will open two more branches in Budapest. In addition to Pecs and Gyor, the bank's regional network will include Szombathely, Szekesfehervar, Szeged, Zalaegerszeg and Kecskemet cities this year, it added.
